evidence.quoted_text:
try:
            with os.fdopen(descriptor, "wb") as handle:
                handle.write(self.token)
                handle.flush()
                os.fsync(handle.fileno())
evidence.reason: The acquire path fsyncs only the newly created token file. `os.open(..., O_CREAT|O_EXCL, ...)` creates a new directory entry, and that entry is not guaranteed durable without an fsync of the parent directory. A crash or power loss after the token fsync can therefore leave no marker after reboot even though the deploy believed admission was held. The surrounding RecoveryRequired/Refused handling shows crash-safe marker persistence is intended, so this is an implementation defect rather than a new hardening requirement. The same durability issue applies to removal.
